label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness): java.util.Random is flagged as insecure for session tokens, which is a known weakness in OWASP benchmarks. Alert 2 (XSS): User input flows through doSomething() via Base64 encode/decode (which preserves special chars) into response.getWriter().println() without HTML encoding - this is a genuine XSS vulnerability. At least one alert is alert-TP.

evidence.note: XSS sink: user input from request.getParameterValues() flows through doSomething() and is printed to response without HTML encoding
Insecure randomness: java.util.Random used for session token generation
